'''Wolfgang Tschirk''' (born 5 October 1956) is a retired [[Austria]]n [[high jump]]er.

He finished thirteenth at the [[1981 European Indoor Championships in Athletics|1981 European Indoor Championships]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.maik-richter.de/results/indoor/europe/1981/m81_07.html|title=1981 European Indoor Championships, men's high jump final|publisher=Die Leichtatletik-Statistik-Seite|accessdate=26 February 2009}}</ref> He also competed at the [[1983 World Championships in Athletics - Men's high jump|1983 World Championships]] without reaching the final.<ref>{{World Athletics}}. Retrieved on 26 February 2009.</ref>

He became Austrian high jump champion eleven times in a row from 1974 through 1984 as well as in 1990 and 1991, his winning streak only broke by rivals
[[Gottfried Wittgruber]] and [[Markus Einberger]].<ref name=aut>{{Cite web|url=http://www.gbrathletics.com/nc/aut.htm|title=Austrian Championships|work=GBR Athletics|publisher=Athletics Weekly|accessdate=26 February 2009}}</ref> He also became indoor champion in 1982, 1983, 1986, 1990 and 1991.<ref name=autindoor>{{Cite web|url=http://www.gbrathletics.com/nc/auti.htm|title=Austrian Indoor Championships|work=GBR Athletics|publisher=Athletics Weekly|accessdate=26 February 2009}}</ref>
